Icons

324 Heroicons (MIT), four variants, one sprite. Colour is currentColor; stroke weight follows the text beside it via --icon-stroke-*. Outline is the default state, solid marks active/selected. Click any icon to copy its usage.

Contract

VariantGridUse forSample
outline 24 default state
solid 24 active/selected state at 24
mini 20 dense UI at 20
micro 16 inline with text at 16

Weight follows text: an icon inside a button or beside 600-weight text renders at --icon-stroke-strong (2px); beside body text at --icon-stroke-regular (1.5px). Direction-bearing glyphs take data-directional and mirror under dir="rtl"; checks, clocks and logos do not.
